messages.author: Ali Saad
messages.body:
Dear All,
If I purchase workstation from Exxact with readily installed Amber, How can I add Amber license to it ? My Amber license will be free since I am in Academia and for research and publication purpose only.
Best regards,
Ali Saad

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, May 25, 2024, Ali Saad via AMBER wrote:
>If I purchase workstation from Exxact with readily installed Amber, How can
>I add Amber license to it ? My Amber license will be free since I am in
>Academia and for research and publication purpose only.
Amber licenses are site licenses, valid for all computers at a given site.
It doesn't matter who installed the software (i.e. you or Exxact): if you
obtain a license from UCSF, it will cover the Exxact machine.
...hope this helps...dac
